svg.title: ServeQ customer service workflow
svg.desc: Three swimlanes show customer actions, backend operations, and business owner actions. Appointment and live queue paths converge at service delivery. Payment collection and delay/cancellation are separate operations. This is a target mobile workflow.

g.text: From discovery to a completed visit
Target customer mobile flow · Appointment and live queue journeys
Full or closed → choose another option
One review for the completed visit
Cancelled visits remain in history and do not become review-eligible.
Green arrows: primary journey. Amber dashed arrows: retry or exception. Dashed boxes: planned mobile work.
Payment collection is independent of service completion. Foreground updates use Socket.IO.
Target design: mobile shell, stable tickets, atomic related writes, and reliable native push still need implementation.
